bifrost: springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs (decode, PNG and JPEG), springboard/src/pngenc.rs (PNG encode), springboard/src/shell/camera/jpeg.rs (JPEG encode with EXIF), springboard/src/shell/photos/exif.rs (EXIF read); no SDK module
summary: Image decoding (PNG and JPEG), PNG and JPEG writing, EXIF reading and writing, and thumbnail downsampling exist inside the system layer and the Photos and Browser apps. Apps get no SDK API for images: no CGImageSource or CGImageDestination equivalent, no GIF, HEIC, WebP or TIFF, no XMP, no animation, and no colour profile handling.

gaps: No SDK module for images: apps cannot decode, encode or read metadata through bifrost_app.
Only PNG and JPEG are decodable and writable; GIF, WebP, HEIC, TIFF, TGA and RAW are not.
PNG writing is uncompressed (stored zlib blocks), so output files are large.
No animated GIF or APNG frame access.
No XMP or IPTC metadata; EXIF read and write is limited to what the Photos and camera code uses.
No colour profile (ICC) or HDR gain map handling; images are treated as sRGB.
No tiled or streaming image provider for very large pictures.
